rationale: Motor vehicle collision with clear vehicle damage and injury to the policyholder resulting from impact.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at red light; policyholder's vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's information in police report; third-party liability likely clear.

case_facts.description: rear-ended collision; other driver traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: vehicle totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
